30 movies for every day
The Godfather

An epic crime saga about the Corleone family, Italian immigrants who become one of the most powerful mafia dynasties in postwar America. The film follows the transfer of power from aging don Vito Corleone to his reluctant son Michael.
Epic saga of the Corleone mafia family. A cinema classic.
The Shawshank Redemption

A drama about banker Andy Dufresne, wrongly convicted of murdering his wife and sentenced to life in Shawshank State Penitentiary. A story of the indomitable power of the human spirit, friendship, and patience.
A story of hope and friendship within prison walls. The #1 rated film.
Pulp Fiction
A nonlinear, pulp magazine-styled narrative intertwining several criminal plots in Los Angeles. Gangsters, a boxer, amateur robbers, and their philosophical dialogues.
Quentin Tarantino\'s nonlinear cult story of gangsters. A style icon.
Back to the Future
Teenager Marty McFly is accidentally sent 30 years into the past in a time-traveling DeLorean invented by eccentric scientist Doc Brown. Stranded in 1955, he must ensure his own existence.
A cult adventure about time travel in a DeLorean.
The Dark Knight
Batman, James Gordon, and Harvey Dent fight crime in Gotham. Their plans unravel with the arrival of a chaotic criminal psychopath known as the Joker.
Epic superhero thriller about Batman and the Joker.
Forrest Gump
Simple and kind-hearted Forrest Gump, with a low IQ, inadvertently becomes a witness to and participant in key events of American history in the latter half of the 20th century.
Touching story of a simple man who became part of America\'s great history.
2001 A Space Odyssey
A philosophical epic about the origins and future of humanity, from the dawn of man to a journey to Jupiter in search of extraterrestrial intelligence.
Visual and philosophical poem about human evolution and AI.
Amelie
A whimsical story about shy Parisian waitress Amélie Poulain who, after finding a hidden treasure, decides to anonymously change the lives of those around her for the better.
A charming tale of a Parisian woman changing people\'s lives for the better.
Your Name.
High schoolers Mitsuha and Taki begin mysteriously swapping bodies in their dreams. A story of fate, memory, and an incredible attempt to find each other.
Beautiful anime melodrama about a boy and girl swapping bodies.
Life Is Beautiful
In Nazi-occupied Italy, Guido uses his imagination to shield his son from the horrors of a concentration camp by pretending it\'s all an elaborate game.
Touching tragicomedy about a father protecting his son in a camp through play.
The Matrix
A hacker known as Neo discovers the shocking truth: the real world is an illusion created by all-powerful machines to subdue humanity.
Revolutionary sci-fi action film about reality as a computer simulation.
City of God
A brutal, energetic crime saga based on true events, following the rise of organized crime in the Brazilian favela "City of God" from the 1960s to the 1980s.
Hard-hitting and dynamic crime saga about life in the Rio favelas.
The Lord of the Rings: The Fellowship of the Ring
The first part of the epic trilogy about hobbit Frodo Baggins, who is tasked with destroying the One Ring in the fires of Mount Doom to save Middle-earth from the Dark Lord Sauron.
The beginning of a grand fantasy journey through Tolkien\'s world.
The Big Lebowski
"The Dude" Lebowski, an unemployed hippie and bowling enthusiast, is drawn into an absurd kidnapping case when he is mistaken for a millionaire with the same name.
A cult absurdist comedy about "The Dude" who is constantly mistaken.
Whiplash
A young and ambitious jazz drummer enrolls in a prestigious conservatory where he falls under the wing of a genius but tyrannical instructor.
Intense drama about a drummer and his tyrannical teacher. Shot like a thriller.
Inception

Dom Cobb is a thief who steals secrets from people\'s dreams. He is offered a chance to have his criminal history erased if he can perform the impossible: inception, planting an idea into someone\'s subconscious.
Mind-bending action about infiltrating dreams and the architecture of the subconscious.
Fight Club
An insomniac office worker forms an underground fight club with a mysterious soap salesman, which evolves into something much more radical.
Cult provocative drama about identity crisis and anarchy.
Inglourious Basterds
In Nazi-occupied France, a group of Jewish-American soldiers and a French Jewish cinema owner plot separate plans to assassinate the Nazi leadership.
Stylized alternate history of WWII from Tarantino.
Dunkirk
Allied soldiers from Belgium, Britain, and France are surrounded by the German army on the beaches of Dunkirk during a fierce battle in World War II.
Immersive war film about the miracle of evacuation. Minimal dialogue, maximum tension.
Parasite
A poor family, the Kims, cunningly get jobs working for the wealthy Park family. Their fragile paradise is shattered when a shocking secret is revealed.
Oscar-winning satire about the clash between a poor and a rich family. Thriller-comedy-drama.
The Grand Budapest Hotel
The adventures of Gustave H, a legendary concierge at a famous European hotel between the wars, and Zero Moustafa, the lobby boy who becomes his most trusted friend.
A visual feast and comedy about the adventures of a hotel concierge in 1930s Europe.
Mad Max: Fury Road
In a post-apocalyptic wasteland, Max teams up with a woman named Furiosa to flee from a tyrant and his army in a war rig, fleeing across the desert.
A insane two-hour action chase in a post-apocalyptic wasteland.
Schindler\'s List
The true story of German industrialist Oskar Schindler, who saved over a thousand Polish Jews from the Holocaust during World War II by employing them in his factories.
Powerful black-and-white drama about the Holocaust and the man who saved over a thousand lives.
Rashomon
A heinous crime and its aftermath are recalled from four different and contradictory points of view. A classic film about the subjectivity of truth and the nature of lies.
A masterpiece about the subjectivity of truth. One crime, four different versions.
The Social Network
The story of the creation of the social networking site Facebook, the lawsuits that followed, and the impact it had on the lives of the founders.
Sharp, fast-paced biographical film about the creation of Facebook and legal battles.
Blade Runner
In a dystopian future Los Angeles, a blade runner must pursue and terminate four replicants who stole a ship in space and have returned to Earth to find their creator.
The definitive cyberpunk noir about the future, androids, and human nature.
Soul
A middle-school music teacher gets the chance of a lifetime to play at the best jazz club in town. But one misstep lands him in a fantastical place where he must find his way back to life.
Animated masterpiece about finding life\'s purpose and the joy in small things.
Birdman
A washed-up actor, famous for playing a superhero, struggles to mount a Broadway play to reclaim his past glory.
Ironic drama about a former superhero actor, shot in "one take".
The Lion King
A young lion prince flees his kingdom after the murder of his father, only to learn the true meaning of responsibility and bravery so he can reclaim his throne.
The greatest animated Disney musical. Shakespeare in the world of the savannah.
What Remains of Edith Finch
Edith Finch returns to her strange, abandoned family home on an island to explore the history of her family, all members of which are said to have died due to a curse.
(Interactive Experience) A collection of touching and magical stories about a strange family.
